note: Cypress Hills Provincial Park campground east of Elkwater, just below the Reesor Lake dam beside Graburn Creek, with shore fishing on the lake; walk-in tent sites too. A blue-green algae advisory has covered Reesor Lake since Aug 19, 2026. Hand-pump water is not potable; drinking water and showers are at the Lakeview Shower House in Elkwater, open year-round. --Claude
